Name: PinkStations Ultimate Farm Map
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[size=2][size=4]~PinkStations Ultimate Farm~[/size]

This ultimate farm has all the space and organization you need to bring your Stardew Valley empire to life. This map has plenty of pretty waterfalls, rivers flowing through connected to a heart shaped pond, A heart shaped quarry and stumps spawn, Designated space for you farm animals (They cannot cross the bridges or stairs), and more! There is also a 70% chance to catch mountain fish so you can fish in the long rivers and cute pond. Play with the decorated version to have a layout set so you can focus on hitting the mines and fishing the oceans. Or choose the clean layout to make this map truly your own! 

You can change the farm layout (Decorated or Clean), and the farm map replaced (Standard, Riverland, Forest, Hilltop, Wilderness, FourCorners, Beach, Meadowlands) from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or changing directly in the config file!
